findings.message: No written North Star exists; write it with the user before this unit is judged. Findings measured against the PR's own claims instead.

Stream lifecycle (caller owns/disposes stream, seeking requires seekable stream, non-seekable limits) is claimed in the PR but absent from XML docs on StreamMediaSource, FromStream and the Stream property.
Tizen only throws when Stream is not null; a StreamMediaSource with null Stream silently does nothing, contrary to 'explicitly unsupported'. Message says 'not yet supported', implying future support.
PR describes StreamExtensions.windows.cs returning application/octet-stream; diff ships a shared magic-byte sniffer (listed as Future). Android file name also differs from description.
Sample is registered and present, but it is unverified whether it demonstrates stream lifetime ownership or Tizen behaviour, both key for secure-app consumers.

Implicit operator is Stream -> StreamMediaSource? on the subclass; C# does not consider operators on subclasses of the target, so the advertised `MediaSource source = myStream;` fails with CS0029. Add `implicit operator MediaSource(Stream)` on MediaSource plus a test.

(int)RequestedLength allocates the full range in one buffer (overflow >2GB); a single Read may be short yet request is finished; exceptions swallowed and FinishLoading() still called instead of FinishLoadingWithError.
Non-seekable streams report ContentLength = 0 (empty resource) and are read from current position; likely cannot play on iOS at all, worse than 'limited functionality'.

StreamDataSourceFactory Java peer disposed before the player's ProgressiveMediaSource that holds it is replaced (also 804-808; same pattern on macios:296 for the loader); loader-thread call into disposed peer can crash.
UpdateSourceStream disposes the MemoryStream the player is still reading before assigning the new source; OnDisappearing (44-52) disposes it without clearing Source.
GetStreamContentType duplicates sniffing instead of reusing shared GetMimeType, maps all non-qt input (incl. audio) to public.mpeg-4, and resets Position in finally without IO/NotSupported guards.
Doc comment says 'on Windows platform' but file is shared; single 0x47 byte check (line 142) classifies any stream starting with 'G' as video/mp2t.
FromStream returns StreamMediaSource unlike sibling factories returning MediaSource, and lacks ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(stream) required by the codestyle guideline this diff adds.

Stream branch sets Player.Source instead of Player.MediaPlayer.Set*Source like other branches; non-seekable streams likely throw from AsRandomAccessStream; created WinMediaSource never disposed on source change.
Open throws InvalidOperationException where ExoPlayer expects IOException, so it is treated as an unexpected error rather than a source error.

Undescribed out-of-scope behaviour changes: File.Open(FileMode.Create)->File.OpenRead fix, HttpClient static->instance (line 32); also unrelated codestyle, LazyViewTests, PopupsPage, Info.plist edits; PR file list wrong.

Delete the magic-byte sniffer: contradicts the PR (octet-stream default, sniffing listed as Future), shared file only Windows calls. Use the default MIME type at MediaManager.windows.cs:344; saves ~160 lines.
Tests exercise only the sniffer; delete with it, saving 283 lines.
Revert formatting churn expanding one-line listener stubs into 4-line bodies; unrelated to streams, ~100 lines of diff noise.
Revert member reordering in File/Uri/ResourceMediaSource; unrelated refactor, plus a stray double blank line.
Unrelated style-rule addition; the end-of-file change drops a closing code fence, likely accidental (rigor counted fences and says they are now balanced).
Whitespace-only unrelated change; revert.
Unrelated test edit (Task.Delay -> polling loop); move out of this PR.
HttpClient static->instance and File.Open->File.OpenRead (line 617) are undisclosed non-stream behaviour changes; revert or call out.
Factory dispose-and-null repeated three times in PlatformUpdateSource and again in CreateMediaItemFromStream; restating comments; ~8 lines removable.
Empty view model is a BasePage<T> repo convention; keep as is (no change).
Title="MediaElement" duplicates the existing page's title; rename to indicate 'from Stream'.

Sample copies the full speed/volume/mute/slider surface from the existing page; only in-memory copy, Open Video and Record Video are stream-specific; ~100 lines removable. Downloading Big Buck Bunny into memory is heavy.
`MediaSource source = myStream;` and `mediaElement.Source = stream;` will not compile (CS0029): the operator lives on the subclass; no test exercises it.
Exceptions swallowed by Debug.WriteLine, then FinishLoading() (line 35) reports success with no data; never FinishLoadingWithError, so MediaFailed gets no cause.
Single Stream.Read may be short yet request is finished (silent truncation); (int)RequestedLength allocates entire to-end range, overflows >2GB.
Non-seekable streams report ContentLength=0 and ignore RequestedOffset, returning wrong bytes silently; cannot play on Apple platforms.
'Works with audio and video' unsupported: GetStreamContentType only returns public.mpeg-4 or quicktime, so MP3/WAV/FLAC are mislabelled; shared sniffer never reaches Apple.
AsRandomAccessStream throws NotSupportedException for non-seekable streams inside an async ValueTask that MapSource does not await; exception unobserved, MediaFailed never fires.

Vacuous test: FromStream is statically typed StreamMediaSource, so BeAssignableTo holds for any non-null return; doesn't assert .Stream == stream. No tests for converter, operators, or platform pipelines.
Sample disposes the stream the player is still reading (also OnDisappearing 44-52), violating the PR's own caller-owns-lifetime guidance.

All StreamDataSource instances share one Stream/Position (races on loader thread); Open throws non-IOException types; after Stop/Play re-prepare a non-seekable stream is already consumed and ends silently.
Previous factory (Android, also 804-808) / resource loader (macios 227, 296) disposed while player still holds old source; in-flight callbacks hit disposed peer.
Throws synchronously from mapper after Unprepare and CurrentStateChanged(Opening), leaving element stuck in Opening rather than MediaFailed.
PR text mismatches code: Windows already sniffs magic bytes (not octet-stream default), file is shared not .windows.cs, Android/macOS file paths differ.
Unmentioned behaviour changes: HttpClient static->instance and File.Open(Create)->OpenRead (586, 617); both real fixes but deserve their own mention/commit.
Out-of-scope edits slipped in: codestyle section, PopupsPage whitespace, MediaSource member reordering, Android listener reformatting (812-928), LazyViewTests flaky-test fix.
FromStream returns StreamMediaSource unlike FromFile/FromUri, breaking the 'follows existing patterns' claim and making the FromStream test unable to fail.
`MediaSource source = myStream;` fails CS0029; add `implicit operator MediaSource(Stream stream) => FromStream(stream);` to MediaSource.shared.cs and a compiling test.

FillDataRequest: int overflow / whole-file allocation for to-end requests, short reads answered as complete, errors swallowed then FinishLoading(); loop in chunks with long math, honor RequestsAllDataToEndOfResource, FinishLoadingWithError on failure.
Non-seekable or disposed stream makes AsRandomAccessStream throw out of PlatformUpdateSource instead of raising MediaFailed; buffer or fail via MediaFailed inside try/catch.

Open/Read throw managed exceptions (InvalidOperation, ArgumentOutOfRange, ObjectDisposed) across JNI instead of IOException/DataSourceException, risking crash instead of OnPlayerError; non-seekable reopen at 0 silently continues mid-stream.

Factory disposed before media source replaced (also 804-808), with SetPlayerData awaited in between; later CreateDataSource on disposed peer throws 'Unable to activate instance' (no JNI handle ctor). Drop reference or dispose after replacement.

Only QuickTime vs MPEG-4 distinguished; MP3/WAV/M4A/ADTS declared public.mpeg-4; duplicates shared sniffer; Read/Position exceptions escape; trailing literal should use DefaultContentType. Map GetMimeType to UTType.

Sample disposes stream before swapping Source and in OnDisappearing while still bound; semaphore ineffective since null check and assignment happen outside it. Clear Source first, hold lock across swap.

StreamMediaSource with null Stream returns stale mediaItem builder and keeps old factory, so old stream replays; same on macios 225-229. Clear factory and return null; guard FromStream with ThrowIfNull.
Any stream starting with 0x47 reported as video/mp2t (false positive); also require sync byte at offset 188. Class summary wrongly says Windows-only.

Only test is FromStream type check; implicit operators (would have caught CS0029), ToString, SourceChanged, converter, Android range logic and macOS loader untested; GetMimeType_DoesNotRewindWhenAtZero misnamed.
Throw happens after CurrentStateChanged(Opening), so state sticks at Opening and exception escapes the mapper; log + MediaFailed + return, or throw before the state change.
